# Swift

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A general-purpose, compiled programming language developed by Apple, used primarily for iOS/macOS app development.

## Scope note

Tags native app components - PKMMeals, PKMStudio (SwiftUI/SwiftData) - as distinct from Python backend tooling.
